languages._comment: Override or add language packs here. Keys: months, months_short, present, date_month_year, date_long, documents, filenames, labels, apply_labels (link texts that lead to the form). See jobapply/i18n.py for the built-in de/en packs.

_comment_operator: The Operator (docs/adr/0004): `operator` is the interactive session `jobapply run` starts for the letter interview (draft-cover-letter); `operator_unattended` runs extract-posting and map-fields with no one watching (claude -p). {skill} and {slug} name the skill and the Application, {tool} is the checkout holding .agents/skills. Keep the prompt before --allowedTools (it is variadic). "" disables a mode; then run that skill in your agent yourself.
_comment_editor: Command `jobapply open` and the [e] key in `run` use to open a file, e.g. "code -r" for VS Code.
_comment_profile_fields: Swiss convention (docs/adr/0003). Dotted paths into the Profile (profile/): required fields block `render`; recommended ones only warn. Edit for another country.
_comment_home_country: Spellings of your own country; the cover letter omits the country line when the employer's address matches one.
